text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: You and me together have got this totally covered! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text: お兄ちゃんと一緒ならこのくらいは余裕だね♪

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text:
But it looks like that monster's not gone yet.
We'd better keep the pressure on, Big Bro!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもあの魔物、
まだまだ復活してくるみたい。
このままじゃ終われませんよね、
お兄ちゃん！
